# Question: generator-shortcuts

The strongest plausible shortcut is:

> Apply the correct interior-fill rule only to hollow frames whose outer height
> and width are both at most 5; ignore any larger frame.

It fits all five canonical labelled pairs, because none contains a frame with an
outer dimension above 5. It also fit the baseline generator's entire support,
because its declared multi-cell shapes were at most `5×4` or `4×5`, even though
`self_check` accepted larger lawful rectangles.

An exact disagreeing input is this `7×11` grid containing one `3×7` frame:

```text
00000000000
00000000000
00333333300
00300000300
00333333300
00000000000
00000000000
```

The intended output changes the middle row to `00377777300`; the shortcut leaves
it `00300000300`. I checked the intended output by executing the selected
canonical Racket authority with `arcpuzzles apply`, independently requesting the
generator-domain check. The retained result is
`checks/repair/large-frame-racket-final.json`; the complete input, intended
output, rival output, hashes, and empty validator findings are in
`repo/generators/82e4aea30adc/counterexamples/large-frame-size-cap.json`.

**Does the proposed generator emit such cases? Yes.** The repaired generator
emits one frame with an outer dimension above 5 in every `multi_only` and every
`mixed` scene. A source-bound probe covered 64 explicit scenes across all four
difficulty settings with zero failures, and 108 held-out query positions with
zero size-cap ambiguities: `checks/repair/large-frame-support-census.json`.
The shortcut is also registered as `ignore_frames_larger_than_5`, so future
semantic/lesson checks exercise it directly.
